entities.summary: Nicolas Roy is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Colorado Avalanche of the National Hockey League (NHL). Roy was drafted by the Carolina Hurricanes, 96th overall, in the 2015 NHL entry draft. Roy won the Stanley Cup with the Vegas Golden Knights in 2023.
